subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862's narrow migration guard and supplied Teams proof sufficient to resolve this issue, or should maintainers require a live packaged upgrade repro first?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear and the open PR targets it narrowly, but the issue is labeled for maintainer review/live repro and the affected path is upgrade-sensitive user state.

options.title: Review and land the linked fix
options.body: Accept the narrow guard if the PR review remains clean, then close this issue from the merge commit and shipped release.

options.title: Require packaged upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until someone demonstrates a 2026.5.x to fixed-build migration preserving a real or fixture-backed Teams conversation source.

options.title: Reject the narrow guard
options.body: Close or redirect the PR only if maintainers want this solved as a broader plugin-state migration contract change instead of a Teams-local guard.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked fix
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow guard if the PR review remains clean, then close this issue from the merge commit and shipped release.

likelyOwner.reason: The central SQLite store and doctor migration history points to steipete as the strongest owner for the upgrade-state decision.
